about: Steven A. Shapiro attended law school and graduated from The Thomas M. Cooley Law School in 1982. Steven Shapiro began practicing law in 1983.
Steven Shapiro is an attorney at Ogborn Mihm LLP, helping people with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues. Ogborn Mihm LLP has an office in Denver, Colorado, serving the local community.

Steven Shapiro was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012, 2020 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
